quarterly_data.signal: As of May 31, 2026 Oracle had $260 billion of additional lease commitments, substantially all related to data center arrangements, not yet reflected on its balance sheet; they are generally expected to commence between the first quarter of fiscal 2027 and fiscal 2029 for terms of fifteen to nineteen years. Its unconditional purchase and certain other obligations, primarily related to data center power arrangements, totaled $13,309 million, and after May 31, 2026 Oracle entered into an additional $19 billion of unconditional purchase commitments for cloud infrastructure assets that commence in fiscal 2027 with a term of five years.
quarterly_data.figure: $260 billion additional data center lease commitments (terms of fifteen to nineteen years); $13,309 million unconditional purchase obligations (primarily data center power); additional $19 billion cloud infrastructure purchase commitments (five-year term)

quarterly_data.signal: Oracle's remaining performance obligations were $638 billion as of May 31, 2026 versus $138 billion a year earlier, the increase primarily attributable to certain significant cloud contracts entered into during the period. Oracle expects to recognize approximately 12% as revenues over the next twelve months, 34% over months 13 to 36, 34% over months 37 to 60 and the remainder thereafter.
quarterly_data.figure: RPO $138 billion as of May 31, 2025; 34% of RPO over months 37 to 60
